topics.title: Write a paragraph about a person who makes a difference.
guiding_questions: Why do you admire this person?
What can we learn from him/her?
topics.sample_essay: My father is a teacher who makes a real difference. He employs fun ways to teach his students. He helps them learn and grow every day. He is always kind and never uses violence. I admire him because he works hard and never gives up. From him, I learned that helping others is the best way to live.
